To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
family members of critically ill patients need assurance, information, and support.
the family members of patients who were admitted to the ICU in a Malaysian hospital ranked “assurance" as their highest need.
family members of patients in the ICU have different needs, which are ranked as “assurance,” “reassurance,” “information,” “comfort,” “support,” and “understanding.”
In summary, our research is concerned with
the needs of family of critically ill patients.
the needs of family of patients in the intensive care unit, particularly in Borneo.
the family needs of the critically ill patients in the ICU.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the most urgent need of the family members is “assurance”.
the needs of family of patients admitted to ICU should be met in order to improve their well-being and quality of life.
the needs of family caregivers are a crucial factor in determining the quality of care provided to the critically ill patients.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the needs of family caregivers of ICU patients are different from those who are not admitted to the ICU.
the needs of family of critically-ill patients are similar, regardless of the cultural background of the family.
the needs of family caregivers of patients admitted to ICU are not only related to their personal characteristics but also to their relationships with patients.
The main takeaway from our work is that
we must be aware of the needs of the family members of critically ill patients, and that we should take the time to meet these needs in order to improve their well-being.
the needs of the family members of patients are not the same as those of the patient.
family members of patients in the ICU need to be assured of the care provided to their loved ones.
